# Golden cerulion/ops/1 frames: each data line is `<case> <hex>`, the hex being
# one whole frame (big-endian u32 payload length, then the JSON payload). The
# `#` line above each case is that payload as text. The hex was produced from
# the JSON text, not by the Rust encoder; the tests require the encoder to emit
# exactly these bytes and the decoder to read them back to the same value.
